defect: The non-binding fixed-dollar compatibility sentinel 1e100 was used directly as economic notional by Fast Shadow, especially MAKER_COMPLETE_SET_SHADOW, producing impossible executable_shares/capital/profit and contaminating aggregate opportunity-profit/bootstrap evidence.

interpretation.hard_arb: No valid hard-arbitrage hit was observed in this window.
interpretation.maker_shadow: Edge observations may remain useful as price diagnostics, but all size-dependent profit/capital/bootstrap quantities from the pre-fix run are invalid economic evidence.
interpretation.promotion: Not eligible. A fresh chronological rerun is required after the sentinel sizing fix.

repair_contract.rule: When max_notional_usd is non-finite or above current PAPER capital ceilings, clamp it to starting_capital times the minimum of market/event/gross percentage ceilings and 100%.
repair_contract.workflow_gate: Fail if any shadow opportunity capital_required exceeds the derived PAPER capital ceiling or any capital/profit/share quantity is non-finite.
